name: nu_zeno_van_Hove
app_psc_label: Zeno Drive frequency ν_Zeno (magnon-polaron avoided crossing)
formula: ν_vH ≈ Δ_ST/h with operative TrpH•+ effective hyperfine ≈ 27 MHz (Ch13 §13.1.2b); 112 MHz is a registered Tier 3 branch value
tier: Tier 1 two-branch model mathematics / Tier 3 realization and value (phason coupling; protected-branch value pending O.12/O.23)
app_psc_precision_str: Mechanism reference: magnon-polaron avoided crossing ν ≈ Δ_ST/h. Operative TrpH•+ effective hyperfine ≈ 27.2 MHz (> FAD•− ≈ 19.6 MHz). The registered Tier 3 branch value ν_c = 112 ± 10 MHz (not an observation) requires a residual factor of ≈3.8–4.5× (Open Problems O.12/O.23). The 30 MHz value is the 3-term FAD rms placeholder only.

extra.hyperfine_source: Wong, Benjamin & Hore 2023, PCCP 25:975-982 (TrpH•+ 0.97 mT, FAD•− 0.70 mT)
extra.withdrawn: the earlier 10-20 MHz indole band and 6-11x factor
extra.derivation_note: Magnon-polaron avoided crossing: solving v_ph k = Δ_ST/ℏ + Jk² in the small-J regime gives k_c ≈ Δ_ST/(ℏ v_ph), and the avoided-crossing frequency on the lower branch is ν ≈ Δ_ST/h. The operative TrpH•+ effective hyperfine is ≈ 27 MHz (0.97 mT; larger than FAD•− ≈ 20 MHz), so the registered 112 ± 10 MHz branch value requires a residual factor of ≈ 3.7–4.5× (Open Problems O.12/O.23; compare the ~41× calibrated (not derived) ratio between g_single^bare = 931 kHz and the calibrated constant g_single^eff = 38.3 MHz per App GPE). The 30 MHz figure is the 3-term FAD rms placeholder only.
